title.zh: Wall Street is building tokenized deposits to lock in customer balances
title.en: Wall Street is building tokenized deposits to lock in customer balances

current_state.zh: DBS and Citi completed a cross-border dollar payment between Singapore and the US in minutes using tokenized deposits on SWIFT's digital ledger, signaling growing bank adoption of blockchain-based settlement to reduce prefunding costs.
